verses.translation: And he brought me into the temple, the porch of which he measured, six cubits the breadth on one side, and six cubits the breadth of the porch on the other side.

translations.ron: După aceea m-a dus în templu, a măsurat stâlpii şi a găsit şase coţi în lăţime de o parte şi şase coţi de cealaltă parte; aceasta era lărgimea cortului adunării.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰσήγαγέ με εἰς τὸν ναὸν, ᾧ διεμέτρησε τὸ αἰλὰμ πηχῶν ἓξ τὸ πλάτος ἔνθεν,

verses.translation: And the breadth of the gateway was ten cubits, and the side-pieces of the gateway were five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and he measured the length of it, forty cubits, and the breadth, twenty cubits.

translations.ron: Lărgimea uşii era de zece coţi şi de amândouă părţile uşii câte cinci coţi. A măsurat apoi lungimea templului şi a găsit-o de patruzeci de coţi, iar lăţimea de douăzeci de coti.
translations.grk: καὶ πηχῶν ἓξ τὸ εὖρος τοῦ αἰλὰμ ἔνθεν, καὶ τὸ εὖρος τοῦ πυλῶνος πηχῶν δέκα, καὶ ἐπωμίδες τοῦ πυλῶνος πηχῶν πέντε ἔνθεν, καὶ πηχῶν πέντε ἔνθεν· καὶ διεμέτρησε τὸ μῆκος αὐτοῦ πηχῶν τεσσαράκοντα, καὶ τὸ εὖρος πηχῶν εἴκοσι.

verses.translation: And he went into the inner court, and measured the post of the door, two cubits; and the door, six cubits; and the side-pieces of the door, seven cubits on one side, and seven cubits on the other side.

translations.ron: A mers înăuntrul templului şi a măsurat stâlpii de la uşă şi i-a găsit de doi coţi, iar uşa de şase coţi; de la ţâţânile uşii până în perete a găsit şapte coţi de o parte şi şapte coţi de cealaltă parte.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τὴν ἐσωτέραν, καὶ διεμέτρησε τὸ αἲλ τοῦ θυρώματος πηχῶν δύο, καὶ τὸ θύρωμα πηχῶν ἓξ, καὶ τὰς ἐπωμίδας τοῦ θυρώματος πηχῶν ἑπτὰ ἔνθεν, καὶ πηχῶν ἑπτὰ ἔνθεν.

verses.translation: And he measured the length of the doors, forty cubits; and the breadth, twenty cubits, in front of the temple: and he said, This is the holy of holies.

translations.ron: A măsurat locaşul şi a găsit douăzeci de coţi în lungime, douăzeci de coţi în lăţime şi mi-a zis: "Aceasta este Sfânta Sfintelor".
translations.grk: Καὶ διεμέτρησε τὸ μῆκος τῶν θυρῶν πηχῶν τεσσαράκοντα, καὶ τὸ εὖρος πηχῶν εἴκοσι, κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ ναοῦ· καὶ εἶπε, τοῦτο τὸ ἅγιον τῶν ἁγίων.

verses.translation: And he measured the wall of the house, six cubits: and the breadth of each side, four cubits round about.

translations.ron: Apo: a măsurat peretele templului şi l-a găsit gros de şase coţi; lăţimea camerelor de pe laturile templului de jur împrejur a găsit-o de patru coţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ διεμέτρησε τὸν τοῖχον τοῦ οἴκου πηχῶν ἓξ, καὶ τὸ εὖρος τῆς πλευρᾶς πηχῶν τεσσάρων κυκλόθεν,

verses.translation: And the sides were twice ninety, side against side; and there was a space in the wall of the house at the sides round about, that they should be for them that take hold of them to see, that they should not at all touch the walls of the house.

translations.ron: În jurul templului sunt trei rânduri de câte treizeci de camere, cameră lângă cameră. Ele intră într-un zid, care este făcut împrejurul templului anume pentru aceste camere, ca ele să fie întărite, dar de peretele templului nu se ating.
translations.grk: καὶ πλευρὰ πλευρὸν ἐπὶ πλευρὸν τριάκοντα τρὶς δίς· καὶ διάστημα ἐν τῷ τοίχῳ τοῦ οἴκου ἐν τοῖς πλευροῖς κύκλῳ, τοῦ εἶναι τοῖς ἐπιλαμβανομένοις ὁρᾷν, ὅπως τὸ παράπαν μὴ ἅπτωνται τῶν τοίχων τοῦ οἴκου.

verses.translation: And the breadth of the upper side was made according to the projection out of the wall, against the upper one round about the house, that it might be enlarged above, and that men might go up to the upper chambers from those below, and from the ground-sills to the third story.

translations.ron: Camerele cu cât sunt mai sus, cu atât sunt mai încăpătoare, subţiindu-se peretele. Din camerele de jos te urci la cele din mijloc şi de la cele din mijloc la cele de sus; suişul este învârtit, căci te sui pe o scară în chipul melcului.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸ εὖρος τῆς ἀνωτέρας τῶν πλευρῶν κατὰ τὸ πρόσθεμα ἐκ τοῦ τοίχου, πρὸς τὴν ἀνωτέραν κύκλῳ τοῦ οἴκου, ὅπως διαπλατύνηται ἄνωθεν, καὶ ἐκ τῶν κάτωθεν ἀναβαίνωσιν ἐπὶ τὰ ὑπερῷα, καὶ ἐκ τῶν γεισῶν ἐπὶ τὰ τριώροφα,

verses.translation: And as for the height of the house round about, each space between the sides was equal to a reed of six cubits;

translations.ron: Şi am văzut un caldarâm înalt împrejurul templului, care slujea de temelie pentru camerele laterale, care avea lăţimea de o prăjină întreagă, adică de sase coti mari.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸ θραὲλ τοῦ οἴκου ὕψος κύκλῳ διάστημα τῶν πλευρῶν ἶσον τῷ καλάμῳ πηχῶν ἕξ· διαστήματα

verses.translation: and the breadth of the wall of each side without was five cubits; and the spaces that were left between the sides of the house,

translations.ron: Grosimea zidului camerelor laterale, care ieşeau în afară, era de cinci coţi, iar lângă camerele laterale era un loc gol.
translations.grk: καὶ εὖρος τοῦ τοίχου τῆς πλευρᾶς ἔξωθεν πηχῶν πέντε, καὶ τὰ ἀπόλοιπα τὰ ἀναμέσον τῶν πλευρῶν τοῦ οἴκου,

verses.translation: and between the chambers, were a width of twenty cubits, the circumference of the house.

translations.ron: Locul gol dintre camerele laterale ale templului şi dintre camerele dimprejurul curţii templului are o lăţime de douăzeci de coţi de jur împrejur.
translations.grk: καὶ ἀναμέσον τῶν ἐξεδρῶν εὖρος πηχῶν εἴκοσι, τὸ περιφερὲς τῷ οἴκῳ κύκλῳ.

verses.translation: And the doors of the chambers were toward the space left by the one door that looked northward, and there was one door southward; and the breadth of the remaining open space was five cubits in extent round about.

translations.ron: Uşile camerelor laterale dădeau într-un loc deschis, o uşă în partea de miazănoapte, iar altă uşă în partea de miazăzi; iar lăţimea locului deschis era de cinci coţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ αἱ θύραι τῶν ἐξεδρῶν ἐπὶ τὸ ἀπόλοιπον τῆς θύρας τῆς μιᾶς τῆς πρὸς Βοῤῥᾶν· καὶ ἡ θύρα ἡ μία πρὸς Νότον· καὶ τὸ εὖρος τοῦ φωτὸς τοῦ ἀπολοίπου πηχῶν πέντε πλάτος κυκλόθεν.

verses.translation: And the partition wall in front of the remaining space, toward the west, was seventy cubits in breadth; the breadth of the partition wall was five cubits round about, and the length of it ninety cubits.

translations.ron: Clădirea de dinaintea locului deschis din partea de apus avea o lăţime de şaptezeci do coţi; zidul acestei clădiri era de cinci coţi de jur împrejur, iar lungimea ei era de nouăzeci de coţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸ διορίζον κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ ἀπολοίπου, ὡς πρὸς θάλασσαν πηχῶν ἑβδομήκοντα πλάτος, τοῦ τοίχου τοῦ διορίζοντος πηχῶν πέντε εὖρος κυκλόθεν, καὶ μῆκος αὐτοῦ πηχῶν ἐννενήκοντα.

verses.translation: And he measured in front of the house a length of a hundred cubits, and the remaining spaces and the partitions; and the walls thereof were in length a hundred cubits.

translations.ron: A măsurat templul; el avea o sută de coţi în lungime; locul liber, clădirea de la apus şi zidurile lui de asemenea aveau o lungime de o sută de coti.
translations.grk: Καὶ διεμέτρησε κατέναντι τοῦ οἴκου μῆκος πηχῶν ἑκατὸν, καὶ τὰ ἀπόλοιπα καὶ τὰ διορίζοντα, καὶ οἱ τοῖχοι αὐτῶν μῆκος πηχῶν ἑκατόν.

verses.translation: And the breadth in front of the house, and the remaining spaces before it were a hundred cubits.

translations.ron: Lăţimea feţei templului şi curtea din partea dinspre răsărit era de o sută de coţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸ εὖρος κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ οἴκου, καὶ τὰ ἀπόλοιπα κατέναντι πηχῶν ἑκατόν.

verses.translation: And he measured the length of the partition in front of the space left by the back parts of that house; and the spaces left on this side and on that side were in length a hundred cubits: and the temple and the corners and the outer porch were ceiled.

translations.ron: Apoi a măsurat lungimea clădirii din faţa locului liber din spatele templului cu camerele laterale de o parte şi de alta a lui şi avea o sută de coţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ διεμέτρησε μῆκος τοῦ διορίζοντος κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ ἀπολοίπου τῶν κατόπισθεν τοῦ οἴκου ἐκείνου, καὶ τὰ ἀπόλοιπα ἔνθεν καὶ ἔνθεν πηχῶν ἑκατὸν τὸ μῆκος· καὶ ὁ ναὸς, καὶ αἱ γωνίαι, καὶ τὸ αἰλὰμ τὸ ἐξώτερον, πεφατνωμένα.

verses.translation: And the windows were latticed, giving light round about to the three stories, so as to look through: and the house and the parts adjoining were planked round about, and so was the floor, and from the floor up to the windows, and the window shutters folded back in three parts for one to look through.

translations.ron: Uşorii uşilor şi ai ferestrelor cu gratii, camerele laterale din cele trei caturi, pe jos şi de jos până Ia ferestre, de jur împrejur erau căptuşite cu lemn. Ferestrele erau închise.
translations.grk: Καὶ αἱ θυρίδες δικτυωταὶ, ὑποφαύσεις κύκλῳ τοῖς τρισὶν, ὥστε διακύπτειν· καὶ ὁ οἶκος καὶ τὰ πλησίον ἐξυλωμένα κύκλῳ, καὶ τὸ ἔδαφος, καὶ ἐκ τοῦ ἐδάφους ἕως τῶν θυρίδων· καὶ αἱ θυρίδες ἀναπτυσσόμεναι τρισσῶς εἰς τὸ διακύπτειν.

verses.translation: And almost all the way to the inner, and close to the outer side, and upon all the wall round about within and without,

translations.ron: Până la înălţimea uşilor, tot peretele, atât la despărţitura cea mai dinăuntru, cât şi la cea mai din afară, de jur împrejur, înăuntru şi pe afară, era împodobit cu chipuri săpate cu anumită măsură;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἕως πλησίον τῆς ἐσωτέρας καὶ ἕως τῆς ἐξωτέρας, καὶ ἐφʼ ὅλον τὸν τοῖχον κύκλῳ ἐν τῷ ἔσωθεν καὶ ἐν τῷ ἔξωθεν,

verses.translation: were carved cherubs and palm-trees between the cherubs, and each cherub had two faces.

translations.ron: Şi anume, erau săpaţi heruvimi şi palmieri, astfel: între fiecare doi heruvimi un. palmier şi fiecare heruvim avea două feţe.
translations.grk: γεγλυμμένα χερουβὶμ, καὶ φοίνικες ἀναμέσον χεροὺβ καὶ ἀναμέσον χερούβ· δύο πρόσωπα τῷ χερούβ·

verses.translation: The face of a man was toward one palm-tree on this side and on that side, and the face of a lion toward another palm-tree on this side and on that side: the house was carved all round.

translations.ron: Heruvimul într-o parte avea o faţă de om, întoarsă spre un palmier, şi în cealaltă parte avea o faţă de leu, întoarsă spre alt palmier. Aşa erau făcute chipuri în tot templul şi împrejur.
translations.grk: Πρόσωπον ἀνθρώπου πρὸς τὸν φοίνικα ἔνθεν καὶ ἔνθεν, καὶ πρόσωπον λέοντος πρὸς τὸν φοίνικα ἔνθεν καὶ ἔνθεν· διαγεγλυμμένος ὁ οἶκος κυκλόθεν·

verses.translation: From the floor to the ceiling were cherubs and palm-trees carved.

translations.ron: De jos până la înălţimea uşilor erau sculptaţi heruvimi şi palmieri ca şi pe pereţii templului.
translations.grk: Ἐκ τοῦ ἐδάφους ἕως τοῦ φατνώματος, τὰ χερουβὶμ καὶ οἱ φοίνικες διαγεγλυμμένοι.

verses.translation: And the holy place and the temple opened on four sides; in front of the holy places the appearance was as the look of

translations.ron: În templu, uşorii uşilor erau în patru muchii. Iar în faţa Sfintei Sfintelor se vedea un fel de altar de lemn.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸ ἅγιον καὶ ὁ ναὸς ἀναπτυσσόμενος τετράγωνα, κατὰ πρόσωπον τῶν ἁγίων ὅρασις ὡς ὄψις

verses.translation: a wooden altar, the height of it three cubits, and the length two cubits, and the breadth two cubits; and it had horns, and the base of it and the sides of it were of wood: and he said to me, This is the table, which is before the face of the Lord.

translations.ron: Altarul era de lemn, înalt de trei coţi şi lung de doi coţi; şi coarnele lui şi postamentul lui şi pereţii lui erau de lemn. Şi mi-a zis bărbatul acela: Aceasta este masa cea de dinaintea Domnului.
translations.grk: θυσιαστηρίου ξυλίνου, πηχῶν τριῶν τὸ ὕψος αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸ μῆκος πηχῶν δύο, καὶ τὸ εὖρος πηχῶν δύο· καὶ κέρατα εἶχε, καὶ ἡ βάσις αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ τοῖχοι αὐτοῦ ξύλινοι· καὶ εἶπε πρὸς μὲ, αὕτη ἡ τράπεζα, ἡ πρὸ προσώπου Κυρίου.

verses.translation: And the temple had two doors, and the sanctuary had two doors, with two turning leaves apiece;

translations.ron: Sfânta Sfintelor avea două uşi şi Sfânta avea două uşi.
translations.grk: Καὶ δύο θυρώματα τῷ ναῷ, καὶ δύο θυρώματα τῷ ἁγίῳ,

verses.translation: two leaves to the one, and two leaves to the other door.

translations.ron: Fiecare din acele două uşi avea câte două canaturi, care se deschideau într-o parte şi în alta, căci două canaturi erau la o uşă şi două la cealaltă uşă.
translations.grk: τοῖς δυσὶ θυρώμασι τοῖς στροφωτοῖς· δύο θυρώματα τῷ ἑνὶ, καὶ δύο θυρώματα τῇ θύρᾳ τῇ δευτέρᾳ.

verses.translation: And there was carved work upon them, and cherubs on the doors of the temple, and palm-trees according to the carving of the sanctuary; and there were stout planks in front of the porch without.

translations.ron: Şi pe ele, pe uşile templului, erau sculptaţi heruvimi şi palmieri, ca şi pe pereţi. Iar în faţa pridvorului, afară, era o pardoseală de lemn.
translations.grk: Καὶ γλυφὴ ἐπʼ αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ θυρώματα τοῦ ναοῦ χερουβίμ· καὶ φοίνικες κατὰ τὴν γλυφὴν τῶν ἁγίων, καὶ σπουδαῖα ξύλα κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ αἰλὰμ ἔξωθεν,

verses.translation: And there were secret windows; and he measured from side to side, to the roofing of the porch; and the sides of the house were closely planked.

translations.ron: Pe o latură şi pe alta a pridvorului erau ferestre cu gratii şi chipuri de palmieri; asemenea erau şi în camerele laterale şi pe căptuşeala de lemn.
translations.grk: Καὶ θυρίδες κρυπταί· καὶ διεμέτρησεν ἔνθεν καὶ ἔνθεν, εἰς τὰ ὀροφώματα τοῦ αἰλὰμ, καὶ τὰ πλευρὰ τοῦ οἴκου ἐζυγωμένα.
